svg.text: V1 Basic clamshell workstation: CNC cut sheets
3 sheets of 4 x 8 ft plywood, 3/4 in thick (T). Red = outside profile, blue = inside cuts, green = 1/4 in drill. Inches.
Sheet 1 of 3 (V1_sheet1.dxf: 5 parts, 91% of the sheet)
Sheet 2 of 3 (V1_sheet2.dxf: 7 parts, 67% of the sheet)
Sheet 3 of 3 (V1_sheet3.dxf: 5 parts, 39% of the sheet)
